items.title: 伊朗据报发射导弹，特朗普考虑达成暂停战争两个月的协议
items.snippet: 据伊朗国家媒体法尔斯通讯社报道，伊朗武装部队向不明目标发射了导弹。美国和伊朗谈判代表已达成协议，暂时结束持续三个月的战争。但白宫官员表示，总统唐纳德·特朗普尚未最终批准这份为期60天的谅解备忘录。2026年5月21日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在华盛顿白宫椭圆形办公室与环境保护署署长李·泽尔丁共同发表讲话时发言。肯特·西村 | 法新社 | 盖蒂图片社。伊朗国家媒体法尔斯通讯社报道，当地时间周四晚些时候，伊朗武装部队向不明目标发射了导弹。此次伊朗南部的军事行动发生在五角大楼称伊朗向科威特发射弹道导弹并在霍尔木兹海峡及其周边部署攻击无人机数小时后。周四早些时候，一名白宫官员证实了Axios的报道，称美国和伊朗已"基本同意"暂时结束持续三个月战争的协议条款。但该官员表示，总统唐纳德·特朗普尚未最终批准这份为期60天的谅解备忘录，该备忘录将延长现有停火协议并启动核谈判。
items.snippetEN: Iran reportedly launches missiles, Trump mulls war deal Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points Iran's armed forces fired missiles at unidentified targets, the state media outlet Fars reported. U.S. and Iranian negotiators have reached an agreement to temporarily end the three-month-old war. But President Donald Trump has yet to give his final approval to the 60-day memorandum of understanding, a White House official said. US President Donald Trump speaks during an announcement with Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Administrator Lee Zeldin in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, DC on May 21, 2026. Kent Nishimura | AFP | Getty Images Iran's armed forces fired missiles at unidentified targets late Thursday local time, the state media outlet Fars reported. The latest military action in southern Iran came hours after the Pentagon said that Iran had launched a ballistic missile toward Kuwait and deployed attack drones in and around the strait. Earlier Thursday, a White House official confirmed an Axios report that the U.S. and Iran have "mostly agreed" to the terms of an agreement to temporarily end the three-month-old war. But President Donald Trump has yet to give final approval to the 60-day memorandum of understanding, which would extend an ongoing ceasefire and start nuclear negotiations, that official said.

items.title: 对可解释的人工智能的偏好--由Alex Chan撰写
items.snippet:
对可解释人工智能的偏好  
亚历克斯·陈  
分享 X LinkedIn Facebook Bluesky Threads 邮件 链接  
工作论文 35240  
DOI 10.3386/w35240  
发布日期 2026年5月  

参与者扮演贷款官员角色，需决定是否批准由美国私人贷款机构发放的1万美元真实贷款，并借助人工智能的违约风险预测。当解释显示人工智能对非白人或女性借款人存在惩罚性倾向时，参与者更可能推翻人工智能追求利润最大化的建议。然而，当奖金与还款率挂钩时，他们倾向于获取预测结果却回避解释，这与故意无知行为一致；当解释被限定为纯财务性质或隐藏人口统计信息时，这一效应逐渐消失。
items.snippetEN: Preference for Explainable AI Alex Chan Share X LinkedIn Facebook Bluesky Threads Email Link Working Paper 35240 DOI 10.3386/w35240 Issue Date May 2026 Participants acted as loan officers deciding whether to approve real $10,000-loans issued by a private U.S. lender using an AI’s default-risk predictions. When explanations revealed that the AI penalized non-White or female borrowers, participants were more likely to override the AI’s profit-maximizing recommendation. When their bonuses depended on repayment, however, they sought predictions but avoided explanations, consistent with willful ignorance; this effect faded when explanations were framed as purely financial or demographics were hidden.

items.title: 美联储首选指标显示4月核心通胀年率如预期达3.3%
items.snippet: 4月份核心通胀年率为3.3%，符合预期，美联储青睐的指标显示。跳过导航 市场 商业 投资 科技 政治 视频 观察清单 投资俱乐部 PRO 直播 菜单 要点 美国商务部周四报告称，4月份核心PCE价格环比上涨0.2%，同比上涨3.3%，而预期分别为0.3%和3.3%。尽管年率符合预期，但温和的月度读数可能带来一些希望，即前一个月的价格飙升已开始缓解。根据美国商务部修正后的数据，第一季度GDP年化增长率仅为1.6%，低于初步估计的2%。本文提及 @SP.
items.snippetEN: Core inflation hit an annual rate of 3.3% in April, as expected, Fed’s preferred gauge shows Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points Core PCE prices in April rose 0.2% for the month and 3.3% for the year, against estimates of 0.3% and 3.3%, the Commerce Department reported Thursday. While the annual rates were in line with forecasts, soft monthly readings could provide some hope that the burst in prices over the previous month had begun to ease. GDP accelerated at an annualized rate of just 1.6% in the first quarter, according to a revised Commerce Department reading that was below the initial estimate of 2%. In this article @SP.
